_note: The town's layout and the ground everyone walks on. Plots sit in rings around the hearth (Frostpunk-style): radius = the ring's middle, age = the tech age that opens the ring, ring_depth = how deep a plot is, plot_width = roughly how wide (each ring gets a whole number of plots per sector), sectors = slices of the circle. Plots touch, so a full stretch of ring is a wall; a lane runs between rings. Buildings place themselves on the free plot that suits them (their "near" key in buildings.json), never on a staked road and never where they would wall off the hearth. obstacles = things already on some plots at the start of a run (count = how many plots). cell = size of a pathfinding square in world units. thickets = patches of scrub out past the town that slow everyone (speed x), radius_min/radius_max = patch size, min_distance = how far from the hearth they start. trail = ground that feet wear into a path by themselves: a square walked on for at least traffic seconds (counted up over the days, x decay each dawn) becomes a trail at dawn, and a trail walked on less than a quarter of that fades back. roads = what stone-layers pave staked roads into, best last: a road kind needs its age; each stretch of stretch_cells squares costs cost and takes work craftsperson-seconds. Stone-layers leave keep_in_stock of each good they use, so building orders aren't starved. A building with "paves": true lets craftspeople pave. speed multiplies how fast anyone walks (heroes, townsfolk and raiders alike).

boulder.name: Boulder
boulder.text: A great stone left by the ice. Nothing can be built here and nobody walks through it.

old_oak.name: Old oak
old_oak.text: A huge oak the elders won't let anyone fell. Nothing can be built here and nobody walks through it.

thickets.name: Thicket
thickets.text: Tangled scrub: everyone walks through it at 60% speed. Feet can wear a trail through it.

trail.name: Trail
trail.text: Worn by feet: anyone on it walks 20% faster. Trails form where people walk most and fade where they stop.

stone_path.name: Stone path
stone_path.text: Flat stones laid by the stone-layers: anyone on it walks 45% faster, raiders too.

cobbled_road.name: Cobbled road
cobbled_road.text: Bronze-age cobbles with a kerb: anyone on it walks 70% faster, raiders too. Stone-layers re-lay old stone paths as cobbles.
